task_instance: User asks: 'I have a Jetson Orin Nano dev kit. How do I flash JetPack onto it using SDK Manager? I don't have the BSP downloaded yet.' The task is to run the skill's discovery workflow: check the live NVIDIA skills catalog (fallback source, since shell/npx is not available in this runtime) and produce a ranked recommendation (skill name, why it fits, install command, first useful prompt) without actually running any install.
evidence: Read the skill doc at benchmark/ce_sources_ext/nvidia__skills__nvidia-skill-finder/SKILL.md. Since this runtime cannot run shell/npx, used the skill's own documented fallback catalog source: WebFetch on https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/skills/main/skills.sh.json (one of the four listed 'Catalog check' sources) with a prompt asking for Jetson/JetPack/BSP/SDK-Manager related entries. The fetch succeeded and returned a real, current list of Jetson-family skills from the live catalog, including jetson-flash-image ('Flash image to device'), jetson-download-bsp ('Download Board Support Package'), jetson-init-target, jetson-quick-start, jetson-print-bsp-info, plus other Jetson skills grouped by product lane (Robotics, Inference AI, Infrastructure, Networking). Wrote user_request.md (the sample task) and response.md (the deliverable: the discovery-workflow output following the skill's Instructions steps 1-5 and its exact 'Recommendation Format', naming up to 3 catalog skills ordered by confidence with install command and first prompt for each, and correctly stopping before running any npx skills add install since no user approval was given). Verified the deliverable by re-reading response.md and confirming: (1) it only recommends skills that literally appeared in the fetched catalog output (no fabricated slugs, per the skill's 'Do not fabricate catalog entries' rule), (2) it follows the required recommendation format, and (3) it does not execute or simulate execution of any install command, consistent with the skill's 'Ask before installing' rule. Files produced: user_request.md, response.md, result.json, all under the work directory.
notes: The one shell-dependent step in the skill ('npx skills add nvidia/skills --list' as the primary catalog check, and the install command itself) was correctly substituted with the skill's own documented non-shell fallback (fetching the raw catalog JSON via a GET request), which this office-assistant runtime's WebFetch tool supports. No install was attempted, which matches the skill's required behavior (recommend only, ask before installing) rather than being a blocker.
